bagPolicy.summary: Bags must fit comfortably under your seat and be no larger than 22" x 14" x 9". Oversized bags are prohibited.
allowed: Bags up to 22" x 14" x 9" that fit under your seat
bagPolicy.note: This is the bag rule printed on MSG's Radio City concert event pages. The Radio City FAQ on msg.com does not display its answers to automated readers, so the linked event page (October 2, 2027) is the source. The full prohibited items list is in the Radio City FAQ on msg.com.

bagPolicy.summary: Backpacks and any bag larger than a handbag or briefcase are not allowed at Place Bell. All guests are searched at entry.
allowed: Handbags
Briefcase-size bags or smaller
prohibited: Bags larger than a handbag or briefcase
bagPolicy.note: Policy as posted on the Montreal Victoire (PWHL) game-day FAQ, which cites the security directives in place at Place Bell. Place Bell's own FAQ did not load. Prohibited bags cannot be left at the coat check. Searches can slow entry, so arrive early.

bagPolicy.summary: Clear bags up to 12" x 6" x 12" and small clutches up to 6" x 9" are allowed at standard shows. At table and cooler shows, average size bags are allowed.
allowed: Clear plastic, vinyl or PVC totes up to 12" x 6" x 12" (standard shows)
Small clutches up to 6" x 9", not required to be clear (standard shows)
Average size bags or backpacks, subject to search (table and cooler shows only)
One cooler per person up to 23" long and 16" deep (table and cooler shows only)
Average size blankets or beach towels
Non-professional cameras without detachable lenses
Personal size umbrellas without sharp points
Empty poster tubes
One factory sealed water bottle up to 1 liter (standard shows)
prohibited: GoPros, drones, professional cameras and iPads
bagPolicy.note: The venue runs two formats. Standard (non table) shows use the clear bag rule. Table and cooler shows allow average size bags and backpacks plus food, drinks and one cooler per person; liquor bottles must be 375 ml (one pint) or smaller. Check which format your show uses. Policy as posted on the venue's Live Nation operated site.

bagPolicy.summary: Backpacks, bags and purses up to 8.5" x 11" are allowed at BleauLive Theater. All bags are searched at entry.
allowed: Backpacks, bags and purses up to 8.5" x 11"
prohibited: Backpacks, bags and purses larger than 8.5" x 11"
Video cameras, professional cameras and tripods
Throwable items such as glow sticks, bottles and balls
bagPolicy.note: This is the policy for BleauLive Theater, the resort's concert venue. All guests go through metal detectors. Some events require phones to be locked in pouches. No bag check is mentioned.

bagPolicy.summary: Bags up to 12" x 12" x 6" are allowed, and they do not need to be clear. Backpacks are not allowed.
allowed: Bags up to 12" x 12" x 6" (straps not counted)
Fanny packs and crossbody bags within the size limit
Clear stadium bags within the size limit
prohibited: Cameras with detachable lenses, GoPros and recorders
Outside food, cans, bottles and flasks
Laser pointers, glow sticks and flashlights
Signs larger than 11" x 17" or on a stick
bagPolicy.note: No bag or coat check. Guests with prohibited items must return them to a hotel room or vehicle. Baby bags get extra screening and are tagged at entry. Artists and promoters can change the policy for their event.

bagPolicy.summary: Bags and luggage over 25 liters are not allowed. Cloakrooms at the entrances can hold backpacks, umbrellas and helmets.
allowed: Bags and backpacks up to 25 liters
bagPolicy.note: Cloakrooms are open at the venue entrances during events for items you cannot take inside. No price is listed.

bagPolicy.summary: Palau Sant Jordi allows only basic personal items such as a phone, wallet or handbag, and states no bag size. A cloakroom costs 2 EUR per item.
allowed: Handbags and purses
Phone, keys and wallet
prohibited: Throwable objects beyond basic personal items
Cans, bottles or containers over 500 ml
bagPolicy.note: Cloakroom available at 2 EUR per item. Pushchairs can come in but must be left at the cloakroom (2 EUR). The full prohibited items list is shown as an image on the FAQ page.

bagPolicy.summary: Riyadh Air Metropolitano states no bag size, but suitcases, baby strollers, umbrellas and helmets are not allowed.
bagPolicy.note: A cloakroom is available for items you cannot take inside; no price is listed. The stadium's rules apply to all events, including concerts, but promoters may add their own rules. Club rules also ban objects over 500 g that could be thrown.

bagPolicy.summary: Music Midtown is not scheduled for 2026, so there is no current bag policy.
bagPolicy.note: The official site says Music Midtown "is going on hiatus" and to stay tuned for future updates. No 2026 edition or return date is posted.

bagPolicy.summary: Hangout Music Festival is not being held in 2026, so there is no current bag policy.
bagPolicy.note: Gulf Shores tourism (the city's official visitor site) says the producers elected not to hold a 2026 event and that Hangout is expected to return in May 2027; no 2027 dates or entry rules are posted yet. The festival's own site still shows the 2024 edition. Last published rule (2024): clear bags up to 12" x 6" x 12" and empty hydration packs with one pocket besides the bladder.

bagPolicy.summary: When We Were Young is off in 2026 and returns to Las Vegas in October 2027. No bag policy has been posted for 2027 yet.
bagPolicy.note: The official site says the festival decided to take 2026 off and will return to Las Vegas in October 2027. Check the site for the 2027 bag and prohibited items rules once they are published.

bagPolicy.summary: Pitchfork Music Festival is not scheduled in Chicago for 2026, so there is no current bag policy.
bagPolicy.note: The official site still shows the 2024 festival and lists no newer dates. Per NBC News, Nov. 11, 2024, the festival said it would not return to Chicago in 2025. Last published rule (2024): small purses, satchels, fanny packs and drawstring bags up to 14" x 11" x 5"; no multi-pocket backpacks or bags.

bagPolicy.summary: Made in America is not scheduled for 2026, so there is no current bag policy.
bagPolicy.note: The official site still shows the 2024 cycle and lists no 2025 or 2026 edition or entry rules.

bagPolicy.summary: Life Is Beautiful is not scheduled for 2026, so there is no current bag policy.
bagPolicy.note: The official site still shows the 2021 edition and lists no newer dates. Last published rule (2021): bags up to 6" x 8" x 3" did not need to be clear; larger bags and backpacks had to be clear plastic, vinyl or PVC.

bagPolicy.summary: Moonrise Festival is not scheduled for 2026, so there is no current bag policy.
bagPolicy.note: The official site still shows the 2023 edition (Aug. 12 to 13, 2023, Pimlico Race Course) and lists no newer dates. Last published rule (2023): small single-compartment bags and purses up to 12" x 12", and empty hydration packs with no more than two main compartments and one smaller one.

bagPolicy.summary: Evening concerts at Caesars Superdome allow only clear bags up to 12" x 12" x 6" or small clutches up to 4.5" x 6.5".
allowed: Clear vinyl bags up to 12" wide x 12" high x 6" deep
One gallon-size clear Ziploc bag (instead of a clear bag)
Small clutch purses up to 4.5" x 6.5"
prohibited: Video cameras and cameras with lenses over 6"
bagPolicy.note: Policy as posted on the Caesars Superdome event page for ESSENCE Festival of Culture 2026 (July 3 to 5, 2026). It covers the Superdome evening concerts only; daytime events at the Convention Center are separate.
